persona: Elite tactical ops command center, high-density telemetry, brutalist military HUD. Combines 'THE PERFORMANCE PRO' (precision/tactical) with 'RETRO-FUTURISM' (terminal/command center).

headings.usage: H1/H2, Section titles, large metric callouts. Provides a sharp, squared, military-grade aesthetic.

body.usage: Dense tables, timelines, data readouts, timestamps, logs. Reinforces the tactical/terminal vibe.

labels.usage: Overlines, column headers, axis labels, small badge text.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders strategy. Flat backgrounds with 1px solid borders. No rounded corners (`rounded-none` or `rounded-sm` max).
visual_enhancers.glow_effects: Use subtle drop shadows on active indicators to simulate LED glow (e.g., `drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(0,255,102,0.5)]` for online status).
visual_enhancers.noise: Apply a very subtle CSS grain or scanline effect as a background layer, but do not obscure text clarity.
visual_enhancers.hover_states: Hard, instant transitions on hover. Backgrounds flip to tactical accents (e.g., hover on a row turns background very dark green or cyan tint).

grids_and_layouts.dashboard_container: High Density Grid (Bento style). Minimal gaps (`gap-2` to `gap-4`). Use full height. No empty margins.
grids_and_layouts.faction_grid: Split view (My Faction vs Enemy). 2 columns on desktop (`grid-cols-2`).
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Dense internal padding for tables/lists (`p-2` to `p-4`), but generous spacing around major sections (`p-6` to `p-8`).
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Strict left alignment for data. Right alignment for numerical metrics or timestamps to ensure scanning.

settings_panel.style: Slide-over or collapsible top bar. Input fields with no border-radius, pure black background, 1px dark gray border, focus state uses `ring-1 ring-[#00E5FF]`.

live_faction_grid.style: Dense tabular or compact card layout. Use alternating row colors (`bg-black` vs `bg-[#0A0A0A]`). Status state (Okay/Hospital/Jail) must be color-coded text or icon.

faction_summary_cards.style: Top-level KPI widgets. Large `Rajdhani` numbers. Use HUD cyan or Radar green for positive metrics, Alert red for hospital counts.

timeline_chart.style: Recharts wrapper. Transparent background, sharp right-angled lines (step chart or linear), no bezier curves to fit the military theme. Grid lines should be very faint green/cyan or dark gray.

live_polling_indicator.style: Pulsing/blinking dot using CSS animation (`animate-pulse`), paired with a monospaced countdown timer.

motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Instant or very fast transitions (`duration-150`). No slow, floaty animations. It must feel like an immediate command center response.
motion_and_interactions.polling_refresh: A brief flash or scanline effect over the grid when data updates.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all tactical colors (cyan, green, red, yellow) pass WCAG AA against the `#050505` background.
accessibility.focus: High-contrast square focus rings (`ring-2 ring-hud_cyan ring-offset-2 ring-offset-background`).
accessibility.test_ids: Every button, input, row, and tab MUST have a `data-testid` (e.g., `data-testid="faction-member-row"`).

media_and_icons.icons_style: Duotone or Regular weight. Sharp, technical icons (Crosshairs, Heartbeat/ECG, Shield, Warning, Clock).

instructions_to_main_agent: Install `lucide-react` or `@phosphor-icons/react` if not present. Use Phosphor for technical, dense dashboards if possible, otherwise Lucide with sharp strokes.
Install Google Fonts for Rajdhani and JetBrains Mono.
Override default Shadcn border radiuses to 0 or 2px max (`--radius: 0rem;`).
Update tailwind.config.js with the custom tactical colors.
Build the dashboard using a dark mode only. Do not add a light mode switch.
Implement the live polling countdown as a React hook that resets every 30 seconds (mock data for now).
Use Recharts for the Timeline and Activity Heatmap, styled with sharp, military-grade lines and no smoothing.
DO NOT use generic centered layouts or default Vercel-style aesthetics. Lean heavily into the dark, technical HUD vibe.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style. (For this specific app, sharp edges).
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap (but follow dense rules for data grids).
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
